justifications.evidence: gate-head-rerun.log records 11 failed / 219 passed at the head against 16 failed / 214 passed at base in /tmp/wsh-base.log, and my own comm of the two logs' FAILED ids leaves exactly the five new test ids base-only with no head-only id; one point is withheld only because the done_when's exclusion set names eight base ids while eleven are excluded.
justifications.fit: ruff check --no-cache and ruff format --check are clean on all three code paths in a git-archive tree at the same revision (measured by me), the helpers follow the module's private-helper and mechanism-docstring idiom, and the diff introduces no plan, ticket or version reference.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/runs.py:1433 makes delivery follow the stream for a seat this host cannot attribute and runs.py:2573 adds the linger fallback, but the hostless branch at runs.py:1492-1494 still erases a hostless record from here once the stream is stale too, a narrower reading of the followup's "never erased by pid alone" than runs.py:1477, which never erases a foreign seat.
justifications.scope_discipline: every one of the five files changed by 9a9cb581..b9a9cf77 lies inside the declared write paths, and the plan edit adds a single landing comment without touching plan meta or resolving the open followup.
